name: Pasta Salad with Peas and Pesto

ingredients.name: packed fresh basil, plus more for garnish
chopped toasted walnuts, plus more for garnish
fresh lemon juice, from 1 to 2 lemons
gemelli pasta, cooked, drained and cooled

instructions.primary_message: To make the pesto, combine the herbs, garlic, cheese, nuts, and lemon juice in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the blade attachment. Pulse several times until finely chopped. With the machine running, slowly add the olive oil in a steady stream. Season to taste with salt and pepper, then set aside.

In a large bowl, combine the pasta and peas. Add the pesto little by little until salad is adequately dressed. Season to taste with salt, pepper and more lemon juice. Garnish salad with chopped nuts and chopped herbs, if desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: pasta, pasta salads, peas, pesto, salad

description: Fresh herb pesto makes a flavorful dressing for a springy pasta salad studded with green peas. Chopped walnuts add delicious crunch and fresh lemon juice brightens it up.
notes: Optional substitutions: packed fresh basil → mint; freshly grated Pecorino Romano → Parmigiano Reggiano; chopped toasted walnuts → pine nuts
author: Jennifer Segal
